query: For my 73‑year‑old female with ACS: among female patients aged 68–78 admitted with ACS whose initial Troponin I (first measured) exceeded 0.04 ng/mL, report patient and admission counts, mean, SD, min–max.
final_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.subject_id) AS patient_count, COUNT(DISTINCT a.hadm_id) AS admission_count, AVG(l.value) AS avg_troponin_i, STDDEV(l.value) AS stddev_troponin_i, MIN(l.value) AS min_troponin_i, MAX(l.value) AS max_troponin_i FROM patients p JOIN admissions a ON p.subject_id = a.subject_id JOIN labevents l ON a.hadm_id = l.hadm_id AND l.itemid = 8716788 WHERE p.gender = 'F' AND p.anchor_age = 73 AND p.anchor_year_group IN (68, 69, 70, 71, 72, 73, 74, 75, 76, 77, 78) AND l.value > 0.04 AND l.valueuom = 'ng/mL' AND l.ref_range_lower > 0.04 AND l.ref_range_upper < 0.04;
